notes.title: Update 1.23 – Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850418/7ed159966d3308693bf312ddb0218ef23cfc90e1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]UPDATE 1.23[/b][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The [i]“Union and Strength!”[/i] achievement was unlocking characters before completing all requirements, for example, showing the Construct already unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the language toggle displayed the wrong language compared to the active one.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue in the button remapping panel in the options menu: if the controller was disconnected during a change, the game froze on the screen, preventing the player from exiting or completing the remap.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Other Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Achievements translated into English.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the [b]Orc (shielded enemy)[/b] HP from 6 to 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Splash Screen volume now follows the audio controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to map mouse buttons in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The current stage number is now displayed in the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added resolution options: the game can now be played in [b]1920x1080 Fullscreen, 1920x1080 Windowed, 1280x720 Windowed, and 960x540 Windowed[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud Save enabled ([b]Warning: switching systems may overwrite your old save![/b]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the button configuration panel in the options menu: now, when remapping a key, it automatically swaps with another already assigned key.[/p][/*][/list][p]These are the changes in this new update, based heavily on the feedback we’ve received. We deeply appreciate all your feedback, both positive and negative![/p][p]We’re also working on extra content for the game — more news coming soon![/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you![/b][/p]

notes.title: HOTFIX – More Money Upgrade
notes.notes:
We fixed an issue related to spending money in the shop to purchase the upgrade that increases the chance of finding more money. Previously, the upgrade was applied but the game didn’t save the purchase. This meant the player received the bonus, but the game didn’t record it, preventing the achievement Wealth of the Abyss from being unlocked.

Other adjustments made in the game:

Balanced the upgrade for more PowerUps: reduced from 10% to 5%, as it was too strong.

Balanced the upgrade for more money: reduced from 10% to 5%, since the effect was overly impactful.

Balanced the upgrade for more fallen characters to rescue: reduced from 10% to 5%.

notes.title: Version 1.21 – Quick Update
notes.notes:
We’ve released a quick update to fix minor bugs that could lead to bigger issues and affect gameplay. Here’s the list of changes to Legacy of Evil:

Updated the pop-up frequency for the Wealth of the Abyss achievement. It will now only display pop-ups every 1,000 gold collected, until the achievement is completed.

Fixed a bug that caused duplicate objects to appear every time the player returned to the main menu.

Fixed an issue with the Reserved Avenger achievement, which was being granted even when the player used the special ability during a run in an area.

Thank you for playing Legacy of Evil. We’ll continue monitoring and improving the game to ensure better gameplay and an even greater experience for you.

notes.title: UPDATE - BUG FIX AND VISUAL ENHANCEMENTS
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850418/7ed159966d3308693bf312ddb0218ef23cfc90e1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We performed a major update to the game to improve gameplay, fix bugs, and implement suggested visual and interaction enhancements.[/p][p][/p][h2]BUG FIX:[/h2][p]- We resolved an issue in the tutorial that was causing bugs and freezing the player in the scene, preventing the game from continuing.[/p][p]- One of the bugs we fixed was the ability to pause at the end of the level, which resulted in an error where the game would not proceed and would freeze on the end-of-level screen, specifically on the leader-switch screen between stages.[/p][p]- Visual bug fixed: we solved a problem that caused characters to teleport and skip the level start in multiplayer when a level began.[/p][p]- We resolved some input bugs where controls would stop working properly at certain moments during gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h2]VISUAL AND INTERACTION ENHANCEMENTS:[/h2][p]- When selecting characters before starting the game, the player now goes directly to the “GO TO ADVENTURE” button when there are no more options to choose, making navigation more dynamic.[/p][p]- The “PRESS ATTACK BTN OR ENTER” prompt on the second player’s HUD now becomes invisible if the player cannot join the match due to a lack of characters, making the game more intuitive.[/p][p]- When performing the ULTIMATE action, visual effects were implemented to add more impact and draw the player’s attention:[/p][p]    - The ground of the environment darkens, providing more contrast and impact to the player’s ultimate.[/p][p]    - When the ultimate recharges, an animation plays to draw the player’s attention. Additionally, an animation on the leader character is triggered, indicating that the ultimate is ready to be used again.[/p][p]- The tutorial text shown when the player dies with all characters has been updated, removing the placeholder text.[/p][p]- Audio control has been implemented in the options menu. Now the player can adjust the MASTER volume, SFX, and MUSIC volumes.[/p][p]- The CREDITS menu has been updated with more information about the team and contributors who helped develop the game.[/p][p]- All game audio has been mixed and adjusted.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing Legacy of Evil! The game’s release is coming soon, later this August. We hope you enjoy the final version of the game.[/p]

notes.title: BUG FIX - Controller Input Desconect
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850418/05119ccb539b982ab5b3408b817638c67d9e9d3a.png[/img]

Hello, in the current tests with the Legacy of Evil game demo at the Steam Next Fest, we have identified an issue that hinders the gameplay. It is related to controller detection at the beginning of the game. The identified bugs are:

[list]
[*] When the PopUp for choosing the connected controller appeared, if the controller was disconnected at this moment and reconnected, the PopUp remained active forever, preventing the window from closing and hindering players from seeing the game correctly.

[*] This problem of disconnecting and reconnecting the controller at the beginning led to another issue, causing Player 1's controller to activate and control Player 2, resulting in a gameplay bug, hindering both single-player and multiplayer experiences.

[*] Fixed the English text: 'Credist' -> 'Credits' on the Main Menu button.

[/list]
